import AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.SingleBlockSeparation
open Matrix MeasureTheory TopologicalSpace
open scoped ENNReal
set_option autoImplicit false
example : (∀ {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 4 ≤ κ),
    let s : ℝ := Real.sqrt κ
    let μ := (Measure.haarMeasure (⊤ : PositiveCompacts (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ)))
    let νpos := (2 : ℝ≥0∞) • μ.restrict
      {O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ | (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det = 1}
    let νneg := (2 : ℝ≥0∞) • μ.restrict
      {O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ | (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det = -1}
    let γ : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :=
      fun O => ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
        ((((κ + 1) / 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) - ((κ - 1) / 4) • ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).transpose)))⁻¹
    let Ppos := νpos.bind γ
    let Pneg := νneg.bind γ
    let δ : ℝ := sSup {z : ℝ | ∃ B : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)),
      MeasurableSet B ∧ z = |Ppos.real B - Pneg.real B|}
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(5 * (n : ℝ)) / s) ≤
      (((s - 1) / (s + 1)) ^ n) /
        (2 + 4 * (n : ℝ) * s / (s + 1) ^ 2) ∧
    (((s - 1) / (s + 1)) ^ n) /
        (2 + 4 * (n : ℝ) * s / (s + 1) ^ 2) ≤ δ) := by
  intro n hn κ hκ
  exact AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.SingleBlockSeparation.single_block_separation hn hκ
result: actual exit0, canonical expanded proposition inhabits the compiled theorem via definitional equality; no new premise
